Episode 205. The Call of the Story (3)
October 27, 1805.

Two days had passed since Elona's seal had been broken. Talaris had been going back and forth between the labyrinth and the kingdom since the moment Elona escaped. She could not stop maintaining the seal of Gito while reconstructing the damaged part of the labyrinth.
"I always knew it would come to this... but it hurts my pride to see the seal broken in my time."
Talaris sighed. She was seated, sending the power of Manbing to various places in the labyrinth. As the power of Manbing seeped in, the destroyed parts of the labyrinth were gradually restored.

"Well, if there is any consolation, it's not a bad time right now. It's an era when our son-in-law and Runcandel, and the Barmel alliance stand strong. Haha, it's the result of my early investment in my son-in-law... Damn it! Why did she have to wake up in my time?"
"Calm down, mother."

"Daughter! Don't you feel embarrassed? Do you know how hard it was for me to keep that seal? Of course, she was going to wake up someday. As I told my son-in-law before, it seemed inevitable that Gito or that woman would wake up. But it could have been later, maybe a thousand years or so."
The small retainers around her approached Talaris, observing her mood. Then, sweating nervously, they rubbed Talaris' shoulders and back vigorously.

[I don't know if it's comforting, but I understand your feelings. Don't blame yourself too much, and it would be good to think about what's to come. I've been guarding the boundary between the surface and the underground, the sealing wall, for at least... hundreds of times longer than you. But I try to think positively.]
"Oh, I'm just a human, so it's hard for me to be as generous as you, Ameris."
She had to escape the seal someday.
Talaris certainly thought that of Elona, but facing reality was inevitably painful.

Talaris was the one who hid the existence of Elona Jipl at the end of the Gliak War, even in a desperate situation. Maintaining Elona's seal is the greatest task that the labyrinth master must take responsibility for.
[As you say, the timing isn't too bad. Maybe it's even a good time. The magician Elona Jipl was always a burden that had to be dealt with someday. From that perspective, now is the right time.]

"I think so too, Labyrinth Master. I lost my sanity when Elona Jipl woke up. I was trying to maintain the seal even if it cost me my life, but in retrospect, it might have been for the best. If I had died opposing Elona two days ago, my damned younger brother would never have been able to return."

When Ameris and even Misha comforted her by patting her shoulder, Talaris could not vent her frustration any more. They were people who had sacrificed themselves for the balance and order of the world for a much longer time than her.

"It's a great relief that there were no casualties in the labyrinth. Luil's arm has recovered, and the injuries of the others were not fatal. And I agree that the time Elona woke up is not too bad. Due to the Zekmin tribe, it will be difficult for Jipl to start another conquest war using Elona Jipl."
As Jin spoke, Valeria nodded.

"The records left by Elona Jipl are quite hopeful too. As soon as Elona woke up, she had a consciousness to avoid killing as much as possible, and she was confused about the meaning of her existence."
Valeria opened the record window.

"When she got out of the labyrinth, it seemed like she had made some kind of resolution, but Elona Jipl is definitely not in a normal state. As Jin saw in the recorded video, her psychological state shows that she can't be seen as a ruthless slaughterer. Like Veradin Jipl, Elona may also have been used by the Jipl and had some internal problems. There's also a possibility that she might not be under Jipl's control as easily as we think."

[Ameris: "I see it that way too. That mortal didn't just become strong through training and experience. If she had ascended so far, her inner self couldn't be so fragile. There's a high possibility that she's a being imbued with the strongest belief of the Sun God, far stronger than what Veil or Hedo possesses."]
Ameris was sure of that. If not, there would be no explanation for the power Elona possessed. She didn't ascend normally, but was of the sort born with special abilities like Yona.

"The strangest point is that up until now, the history of Elona Jipl has been erased. The main culprits who altered history must undoubtedly be Jipl, so maybe Elona was their scapegoat. They wouldn't erase the history of the Grand Mage of a proud lineage."
For the Barmel alliance, this was the best hypothesis.
If there was some sort of problem between Elona and Jipl and that caused the historical alterations, there would be no reason for Elona to fight for Jipl.

Of course, the appearance of a suddenly uncontrollable ascended mage was extremely burdensome either way. The fact that Elona had headed for the Tower of Stories was also recorded, so for the time being, Jipl's power had dramatically increased.
[Ameris: "We need to carefully watch the situation for now. Unless Jipl goes mad, they won't strike our alliance with Elona in this situation."]

Even with the addition of an ascended mage, Jipl was in no position to lightly touch the Barmel alliance. There were too many variables. The invasion of the red-haired tribes, the complete control of Elona, and so on.

In particular, 'the power of the Barmel Alliance' itself was bound to be burdensome. It can't be concluded that Elona can overwhelm the power of the half-god Ban and Murakan revealed in the temple of the malevolent gods.

"Hmm, among the spells used by Elona Jieful, there was one that restricted spatial movement. That's why I couldn't immediately enter the labyrinth, and the same goes for my son-in-law. If this applies to the Red Demons as well, they will have to be anxious even when attacking areas other than the Tower of Tales."
[That, in turn, means that Elona can't easily leave the Rutele Federation.]

"That's true. But, do those demons have the ability to confront such a monster? Looking at their records so far, they seem somewhat weak against the top superhumans. They've decided not to even touch the Barmel Alliance because they're scared of my son-in-law."

[They would have it. So far they've been struck by top superhumans or things like Demon Stones, but the Red Demons haven't fully regained their prime power. Among the characters, it seems that no one else except Tushin or Bacaroon Yong can fight Elona, but if the air fortress is added, the story would be different.]
"That monstrous thing you're talking about is different from an airship. I heard it incinerated the Rislit Autonomous Region of the Federation in a moment during the last invasion."
[Just because you have a powerful individual doesn't guarantee a win in a war. The Red Demons are really stubborn and terrible.]

"But the Red Demons decided to target Jieful instead of the Alliance because they're scared of my son-in-law. If the Red Demons think Elona Jieful is stronger than my son-in-law? Then couldn't they switch their invasion target from the Federation to the Alliance?"
[If it were me, I wouldn't. Unless Jieful can freely move dimensions like our alliance. No matter how strong Elona Jieful is, can she support the invasion areas faster than Jin?]
Based on the records so far, the power of Elona at her prime is estimated to be on par with, or more than, Temar.
However, there's no guarantee she's still as powerful after just waking up from the seal, even if Elona gradually recovers and greets her prime again.

Jieful's best hand was still Elona Jieful, but the Demon Stone. Completing the historical manipulation through the Demon Stone was the biggest task of Jieful. There's a clear limit to what can be done with 'individual power' alone.
However, Jin knew that Elona could play a significant role in 'historical manipulation'.
-<Elona Jieful and 3,036 magicians tried to manipulate the history of Temar Runkandel, but failed to overcome the power of his mighty existence.>

-<On March 3, 797, five magic towers in Jieful in the Kingdom of Faelin are operating intact. Since their completion, these towers have never been attacked from the outside and remain the same as 57 years ago.>
The records confirmed in the third tomb in the past.
At that time, Jieful failed to manipulate Temar's history, but there was a record of making the history of Temar and the ten knights destroying five towers 'nonexistent'.

'Presumably, Elona Jieful had the greatest influence on erasing the history of the destroyed tower in that record. So, if Jieful can perfectly control Elona Jieful, it would spur the completion of historical manipulation....... I need to meet Elona Jieful once. We need to find out why Elona was erased from history.'
And if possible, he wanted to make her an ally one day, as he had decided before the past Battle of Horrors.
"I'll have
to meet Elona Jieful in person soon. If Elona is in the same state as Veradin, I might be able to help her. Since Jieful is unlikely to allow the meeting easily, we need to think of a way."
The colleagues did not doubt Jin's judgement, even though it was a risky task. Without more than conjecture, they couldn't know anything about Elona or her relationship with Jieful.
Also, they weren't too worried. Even if a battle ensued, they believed Jin wouldn't die in vain, even if he faced Elona at her prime.
Most importantly.
Jin had no plans to meet Elona alone.
"Miss Misha will return as a representative of Soldelet soon, so it would be good to move with Murakan then."
Murakan was about to return to the Barmel Alliance.
